assessments.reasoning: Authenticity follows from publisher_pin at the Creative Commons legal-tools repository commit 91780e140892982eb3e0d530591ccbbca0d4690d and the matching publisher_live file on creativecommons.org. Integrity follows from the matching cited digest for publisher_pin [0,48) and the scoped whole-file digest on both copies. Relevance follows from the title at [0,48). Interpretation follows from its paired headings “Creative Commons Legal Code” and “CC0 1.0 Universal”. Applicability follows from the pinned docs/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt path and the English body. On contradiction, sections 2 and 3 contain the operative dedication and fallback, consistent with the title and inconsistent with identifying this file as a mark or summary.

Authenticity follows from publisher_readme in the same publisher repository and commit as publisher_pin. Integrity follows from the matching reported digest for [4999,5294). Relevance follows from the Public Domain Tools example in that range. Interpretation follows from its explicit title, identifier, version, Universal designation and language code en. Applicability follows from its canonical /publicdomain/zero/1.0/ URL matching the parent path of publisher_live. On contradiction, the README's Data section calls CC0 a public domain declaration and the example places it under publicdomain. Both agree with the proposed instrument identity while limiting what can be attributed to the publisher about registry kind.

challenge.method: Tested whether the evidence could identify the Public Domain Mark, a different edition, or a deed summarizing CC0 instead of the instrument itself. Used the publisher's title, namespace fields and operative provisions without relying on SPDX.
challenge.results: The publisher specifies unit “zero” and version “1.0”. The file contains an Affirmer's waiver and a fallback license, which distinguish this dedication from a mark identifying existing public-domain status. The legal-code heading, legalcode.txt path and numbered operative clauses distinguish the file from a summary.

limitations: Creative Commons describes CC0 as a public domain dedication. The proposed registry kind “license” and lifecycle state “active” are index choices.
The live and pinned plaintext are two copies from the same publisher lineage. Their agreement establishes consistency.
reasoning: Creative Commons names the instrument “CC0 1.0 Universal” in the English legal code itself. Its legal-tools documentation independently of SPDX supplies the same title, version 1.0, Universal jurisdiction designation, English language code and canonical zero/1.0 path.
